t: You're looking at a bronze statue of Clement Attlee on the Mile End campus of Queen Mary University of London. Frank Forster made it in 1988 for the Greater London Council, which had meant it for Mile End Park. By the time it was finished the council had been abolished, so Tower Hamlets Council paid to put it outside Limehouse Public Library, honouring Attlee as the area's member of parliament. Harold Wilson opened it. Attlee was Prime Minister from 1945 to 1951 and the longest-serving Labour leader. Vandalism later led to the statue being boarded up.
